semantic.justification: Composes the browser Writer session from document, shell, frame, persistence, and presentation adapters without claiming the upstream swmodule implementation path. Iteration105 restores the existing paragraph StyleApply slot5552 to the stable SwDocShell owner with active SwView/GetWrtShell lifecycle, retaining the text-shell paragraph primitive. Caller-owned typed Template5552/Family5553 and Style6703/FamilyName5566 arguments and ordinary UNO/URL payloads preserve paragraph family2 defaults and recognized family-name precedence, paired programmatic-to-display conversion, actual custom or renamed style ownership, missing-name rejection, no-op family success and unsigned owner completion. Dispatcher preserves completed owner return items. Independent real model/view/frame/session tests cover current-style ID state, point/mark, history, graph replacement and instance isolation. Other style families, StyleDesigner, API-mode returns, modifier/reset/list/full-selection handling, the complete native style pool and native state itemset remain unverified; no status/default/exception promotion or registered save/open/recovery changes. Task165 replaces hardcoded Writer role-family lists and permissive CSS check presence tests with a generic DefaultFontType/prepared Locale browser binding. Existing source-configured lists, UTF16 tokens and search-name normalization match actual registered FontFace families; synchronous queries require loaded faces and async preparation loads all faces of candidate families in order, continuing after failures. Writer owns its native text/heading/FIXED role mapping; main awaits font preparation before mounting document factories. CSS descriptor decoding preserves registered family names. Browser/system fonts outside the registered FontFaceSet are not guessed or permission-enumerated. Full physical best-match/substitution, user configuration overrides, remaining Font attributes and Writer legacy requested-family fallback policy are not represented by this bounded device; Calc document/UI/ODS remain pending. No fake PhysicalFontCollection, native compiler/probe or lifetime manager.
